verdict.rationale: Omarchy's docs say you can install Ruby on Rails, Laravel, Node.js and "a long list of other development environments" straight from the Install > Development section of the Omarchy menu. Mise handles per-project language versions, and editors like VSCode, Cursor and Zed are ready to install with theme matching. That clearly covers quick, preconfigured setup for popular frameworks and languages. Missing for 10: a documented full list of the supported environments and what each preconfiguration includes, and independent hands-on reports of the dev-environment installer specifically (community praise is only about general install ease).
